AcsTolerances.description: FAA-S-ACS-8 task tolerances. Timing/leg margins are instructor criteria, not ACS quotations.

ApproachIntercept.description: A heading and altitude restriction remain in force until the final course is established.

oneOf.description: Touch-and-go landing clearance (JO 7110.65 3-9-4); used for circuit traffic.

ident.description: "Squawk ... and ident": the controller also wants the IDENT button pressed.

oneOf.description: "Ident": press IDENT on the transponder (radar identification).

temperature_c.description: Sea-level reference observations; station temperature uses a standard lapse rate.

Instruction.description: Typed meaning shared by scripted and live facility transmissions. No automatic ATC rules.

oneOf.description:
Listening discipline on a busy frequency: answer traffic advisories, answer only calls that
use your callsign, and do not transmit over others.

minimum_ft.description: Explicit, instructor-selected training minimum; CIFP does not encode plate minima.

traffic.description:
Busy-airspace traffic switched on at the start, with the user already in radar contact with
the approach controller of `airport` on COM1.

oneOf.description: Lined up on a runway end, ready for takeoff.
In the air at a magnetic bearing and distance from the airport.

bearing_deg.description: Magnetic bearing from the airport to the aircraft, degrees.

clearances.description: Airspace ids for which this planned flight has clearance.

route.description: Route samples carry explicit MSL altitude and clearance assumptions.

start.description: Where "Start here" puts the aircraft. Omitted, a scenario runs only on the current flight.

oneOf.description: A wait installs a condition on advancement to the next step.

ScenarioPlacement.description: An installed region and a position in it, by an airport in that region.

when.description: All conditions must hold. Steps execute in file order unless a branch jumps forward.

TurbulenceLevel.description: Original scenario presets: RMS gust velocity on each NED axis, m/s.

Weather.description: Wind speed is specified at 10 m AGL. Direction is meteorological (blows FROM).
